purpose: Reviewed localized finger-side color correction paired with native source-coverage restoration
method: Same-source, same-finger trusted observed neighbors within .005 raw units (expand to .008 only if fewer than8); at most36 nearest, robust median and MAD; replace only >.035RGB and >2.5MAD outliers. No geometry, covariance or opacity changes. Two traced back-source index discoloration rows additionally use up to24 plausible same-finger opposite-capture neighbors within .012 scan units, RGB change capped at .25 per channel.
status: accepted after isolated and full-hand multi-angle review
